answer: Split-tally bond stops mass fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits, registers a walnut grove, and splits its claim in two: half A on the umber board, half B sealed by the forge. An auditor pairs halves by serial; a doubled, mismatched, or missing half burns the bond. Each fake pays two fees: first 42, k-th 42+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,038,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented-half ring cannot share halves. Honest agents pay 42 once and keep their share.
